steps.customerMeaning: Understand what you are trying to work through before choosing a product or method.
Establish the relevant current situation, known facts, constraints and open questions.
Read governed knowledge, perspectives and findings without collapsing their source classes.
See possible directions, trade-offs, dependencies and what may be useful next.
Turn a chosen direction into an explicit real-world action owned by the customer or professional.
Observe what actually happened and what new evidence appeared.
Review what changed, what remained and which assumptions still hold.
Continue with updated context rather than restarting from zero.
